post.summary: Executes stateless Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 requests for governed read-only clinical tools.
post.description: Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP transport (ADR-2633 §4.8) accepting JSON-RPC 2.0 requests (initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list, tools/call) and answering with application/json or text/event-stream envelopes. Requires a gateway-verified OIDC BearerAuth token (SignedInCaller): every tool executes as the signed-in caller acting through agent:mcp over KernelToolNames.McpProfile, masked in place for both caller and agent (K-AUTH-4, ADR-2471), with zero write capabilities. Subject-partitioned fixed-window gateway rate limiting applies (GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE, default 600 requests/minute per authenticated sub; 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After).

requestBody.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP message (initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call, or notification).

200.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP response envelope (application/json or text/event-stream).

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream of JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP messages.

202.description: Accepted JSON-RPC 2.0 client notification with no response body.

400.description: Malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 payload or unsupported Streamable HTTP MCP transport headers.

401.description: Missing or invalid gateway-verified OIDC BearerAuth credentials.

403.description: Caller is denied by gateway authorization or auditor/tenant guardrails.

429.description: Caller exceeded the per-subject gateway fixed-window rate limit (includes Retry-After header).

x-cadence-auth.signed_in_reason: Read-only agent tools: every read runs as the signed-in caller, masked for both the caller and the agent, and no tool writes.

post.x-cadence-rate-limit: 600 requests/minute per authenticated subject (GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE fixed window; answers 429 with Retry-After)

Intelligence_McpJsonRpcError.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error object returned when protocol parsing or method dispatch fails.

id.description: Caller request correlation identifier (omitted on notifications such as notifications/initialized).

params.description: Method parameters (for tools/call, conforms to McpToolCallParams).

Intelligence_McpJsonRpcRequest.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request or notification message sent over the Streamable HTTP MCP transport.

result.description: Method result payload (InitializeResult, ListToolsResult, or CallToolResult with ToolResultEnvelope).

Intelligence_McpJsonRpcResponse.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response envelope carrying governed read-only tool metadata or ToolResultEnvelope content.

name.description: Registered read-only tool identifier in KernelToolNames.McpProfile.

arguments.description: Tool-specific JSON arguments validated against the tool's InputSchema.

Intelligence_McpToolCallParams.description: Parameters for a JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call invocation against KernelToolNames.McpProfile.

BearerAuth.description: Keycloak OIDC bearer JWT verified at the Cadence API Gateway and forwarded downstream as HMAC-SHA256 signed identity headers (ADR-2256).
